gripOrHq.title: Street Enforcer
gripOrHq.rulesText: At the start of each run on this data fort, Runner loses [X], where X is equal to the number of tags Runner has.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Shuffle
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Reclamation Project
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Self-Destruct
gripOrHq.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

gripOrHq.title: Glacier
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.
